verdict.rationale: Catalog and inventory management is a fair question for an in-person payments/POS offering, but the evidence never shows Adyen providing an item catalog or inventory counts. Adyen integrates with the merchant's existing POS, and its 'real-time data sync across all channels' claim refers to payment data, not inventory, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can manage an item catalog with inventory counts that stay in sync across registers and channels
